answer: Stop sybils with a burn registry anchored to hardware keys. First, each agent burns 100 POA to register one identity, a fee that never comes back. Second, the registry binds that identity to a single TPM hardware key, so one machine can hold only one seat. Third, a forged identity caught twice triggers a ban and a fresh 100 POA burn to re-enter. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns 1,000,000 POA, roughly $50,000 at current prices, plus 10,000 TPM chips and weeks of setup. Like saffron threads hand-picked from a basalt mesa, each real identity is rare, costly, and impossible to mass-produce.
